audit: ARX 4.0.0 Beta 1 bounded Hypothesis fuzz triage
release_blocking_definition: A release-blocking item prevents this fuzz gate from being accepted for a future production-publication review. It does not alter or retroactively withdraw the immutable Beta 1 artifacts.

failures.intended_property: Every bounded OpenAI response payload either yields non-empty advisory text or a ProviderError carrying a documented PARSE_FAILURE or SERVER_FAILURE status.
failures.minimal_counterexample_category: Empty provider error object, empty response object, and non-object null response.
failures.observed_behavior: The product parser raised the documented ProviderError categories SERVER_FAILURE and PARSE_FAILURE. The property then failed because it compared the uppercase enum values against lowercase string literals.
failures.expected_behavior: The property should compare against the actual documented enum values, or compare enum members directly. The product behavior represented by these counterexamples already conforms to the intended outcome set.
failures.security_relevance: Provider response parsing must fail closed and preserve a sanitized operational category for malformed or server-error responses.
failures.audit_gate_impact: The generated cases exercised the product parser; the failure was confined to an incorrect case-sensitive assertion in the audit property.

failures.intended_property: A bounded, truncated PE optional header is classified as a Windows PE and produces an inspection error without an unhandled exception or mutation of the input file.
failures.minimal_counterexample_category: No generated product counterexample; Hypothesis stopped at collection/execution setup because the property used a function-scoped tmp_path fixture.
failures.observed_behavior: Hypothesis raised FailedHealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture before the product scanner was exercised.
failures.expected_behavior: The harness must provide fresh per-example temporary storage so all generated malformed PE inputs reach the scanner under the stated bounds.
failures.security_relevance: Malformed executable metadata is an untrusted parsing boundary; the intended robustness property remains untested by this campaign.
failures.audit_gate_impact: Blocks acceptance of the fuzz gate for production review because this property did not execute; it is not evidence of an ARX product defect.

failures.intended_property: Sensitive assignments are redacted at the external boundary and the resulting bounded context remains JSON-serializable without NUL characters.
failures.minimal_counterexample_category: A generated credential token also appeared independently as an ordinary background mapping key; the actual credential and labeled assignment were redacted.
failures.observed_behavior: The product replaced the credential field and the labeled api_key assignment with redaction markers. The assertion searched the entire serialization for the generated token and found the independent background key, which the generator had not designated as a sensitive field.
failures.expected_behavior: The property must avoid independently aliasing the chosen token into non-sensitive generated data, or explicitly define a cross-field taint-tracking requirement before asserting global token absence. The present implementation is context/pattern based, not cross-field taint tracking.
failures.security_relevance: External-boundary redaction protects credentials and other sensitive values, but an over-broad oracle can incorrectly report leakage when unrelated data happens to equal a generated token.
failures.audit_gate_impact: The minimal example demonstrates generator aliasing and an over-broad oracle, not failure to redact the credential-bearing positions.

failures.intended_property: Bounded package.json metadata in a directory is parsed without executing content and without removing the source file.
failures.minimal_counterexample_category: No generated product counterexample; Hypothesis stopped at setup because the property used a function-scoped tmp_path fixture.
failures.observed_behavior: Hypothesis raised FailedHealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture before scan_software was called.
failures.expected_behavior: The harness must create isolated per-example directories inside the property before generated metadata is passed to the scanner.
failures.security_relevance: Project/package metadata is an untrusted local input boundary and must be parsed without code execution.
failures.audit_gate_impact: Blocks acceptance of the fuzz gate for production review because this property did not execute; it is not evidence of an ARX product defect.

failures.intended_property: A bounded ZIP with generated metadata and entries is inspected without extraction, reports stable archive metadata, and does not create additional files.
failures.minimal_counterexample_category: No generated product counterexample; Hypothesis stopped at setup because the property used a function-scoped tmp_path fixture.
failures.observed_behavior: Hypothesis raised FailedHealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture before an archive was generated or scan_software was called.
failures.expected_behavior: The harness must create fresh per-example temporary storage inside the property so bounded archives reach the scanner and extraction side effects can be measured.
failures.security_relevance: Archive metadata and member names are attacker-controlled local inputs; bounded non-extracting inspection is a material parser-security property.
failures.audit_gate_impact: Blocks acceptance of the fuzz gate for production review because this property did not execute; it is not evidence of an ARX product defect.

gate.reason: Three security-relevant properties never reached ARX product code because of a harness fixture defect. Two other failures are demonstrably incorrect test assumptions. The campaign therefore cannot be reported as passed, even though its recorded failures establish no ARX product defect.
gate.remediation_scope: Correct and independently review the audit harness in a future audit change, then rerun the bounded campaign. No Beta 1 product code or immutable release artifact is to be changed as part of this triage.
